title_zh: 约定从开放观景台观察蝙蝠

scenario.label_zh: 确认保护区蝙蝠观赏位置
scenario.goal_zh: 了解洞穴与悬崖步道的关闭限制，决定随导览前往开放观景台

context_zh: 游客询问保护区工作人员，如何在不干扰蝙蝠的情况下观看它们离洞。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Suri
sentences.text: Is the cave open to visitors? We'd like to see the bats.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: No. A large colony lives inside, and keeping people out is part of our conservation work.

sentences.speaker: Suri
sentences.text: Can we watch from the path along the cliff instead?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: That path is closed too, but the lower viewing platform is open. You can see the entrance from there.

sentences.speaker: Suri
sentences.text: Do we need to climb down to it?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: No, there's a marked level path from the visitor centre. The evening guide will lead a group at seven.

sentences.speaker: Suri
sentences.text: We'll join that group and stay on the platform.
